title: Externships at Pineville and Mercy Hospital
summary: Steinau describes his medical externships doing histories and physicals, housed in a condemned building.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: at the state hospital at Pineville and I was extern for a few months at the old Mercy Hospital down by the river.
That was during the summer too?
No that was during the fall.
I didn't understand how that worked or anything.

It was a filling in sort of a job. There were several of us that did histories and physicals basically. The scut work, that's S-C-U-T, that needed to be done that they didn't have more qualified people to do.
Yeah so that wouldn't have kept you there during the summer?
No, no, no. I wasn't there that long anyway.
Yeah I just very vaguely remember that.
Yeah they had us housed in a literally condemned building at the time.
